title: Bohemian Rhapsody
description: The unmistakable vocal melody of Queen's masterpiece, arranged in C major from the official Phillip Keveren easy piano score.
generalTip: Play the right-hand vocal melody with expression. Start on Finger 3 on G for "Mama". Keep the tempo steady at 72 BPM.

sections.label: "Mama, just killed a man"
tips: 👑 The iconic opening phrase: "Mama, just killed a man"
👆 Start on G with Finger 3 for "Ma-ma", step up to A (Finger 4) on "just"
🎵 "Put a gun against his head": quick repeated A notes then step down to G and F

sections.label: "Life had just begun"
tips: 👆 Finger 1 on E, Finger 2 on G for "life had" — then leap to C (Finger 5) on "just begun"
🎵 "Now I've gone and thrown it all away": four steady C notes stepping down to B then resolving to D
✨ Hold the long D note for the full 4 beats

sections.label: "Mama, ooh..."
tips: 💧 Finger 2 on F for "Ma-ma" — tender and weeping
🖤 _A is Ab (black key) for the weeping "ooh" expression
🎤 "Didn't mean to make you cry": step down smoothly from A to G to F to E, landing on D

sections.label: "Carry on" & Outro

💪 "Carry on, carry on": the uplifting repeated E-C motif
🏁 "As if nothing really matters": gentle step down to G below middle C
